speaker: Doctor
text:
I need to understand more about this rash and its progression. Has the rash appeared in other areas of your body, or is it strictly limited to your hands and feet?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, ESR, CRP.

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is quite concerning given the misdiagnosis of pneumonia; your symptoms strongly suggest a different underlying condition. Please describe the texture of the rash on your upper body and face, and have you noticed any recent hair loss on your scalp? REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_B12, Folate, Paraprotein_electrophoresis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal labs; since your labs are normal and you have hypopigmented macules on your elbows along with numbness in the palms, can you tell me if the skin lesions look "punched out" or have a specific border? Also, do you have any other neurological symptoms like difficulty walking or swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatoscopy of elbow macules and scalp. Given your farming occupation and the specific skin findings, could you describe any recent exposure to soil or potential leprosy contact, and have you noticed any loss of sensation to touch on your arms or legs?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.
